name: gclone-auth
description: gclone's auth Worker: the Google sign-in of one person's gclone devices and of the hosted viewer

scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-config.mjs && node scripts/check-release.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/check-config.mjs && node scripts/stub-dist.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs --not-a-release && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: node scripts/check-config.mjs && node scripts/stub-dist.mjs && node --test scripts/check-config.selftest.mjs scripts/stub-dist.selftest.mjs scripts/check-dist.selftest.mjs scripts/release-bundle.selftest.mjs scripts/setup.selftest.mjs scripts/custom-domain.selftest.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:browser: node test/e2e/run.mjs chrome webkit firefox && node test/e2e/signin.mjs && node test/e2e/local.mjs chrome webkit firefox
